Why our websites work

Three jobs. Every single page. In this order.

Most agencies hand you a brochure and call it a website. We build every page to do three jobs — because a site that isn’t found, doesn’t convert, and doesn’t generate enquiries isn’t an asset. It’s a bill.

01

Visibility

Built to be found from day one — in Google and in AI answers. Schema, clean technical structure and SEO content are baked into the build, not bolted on later.

02

Conversion

Every layout decision is a conversion decision. We design the path from landing to enquiry during the build, so visitors actually pick up the phone or fill in the form.

03

Leads

Success isn’t launch day — it’s the enquiry that lands next Tuesday. We build, track and measure for one outcome: more qualified leads for your business.

The Nifty difference

Every website ships with a $2,000 SEO build — free.

Other agencies charge thousands for search visibility, or leave you to figure it out. We write and build it into every site as standard, so you launch ready to rank — not waiting for a “phase two” invoice.

mainEntity.name: How much does a website cost in Australia?

acceptedAnswer.text: Nifty Websites Australia builds websites from $499 for a starter site, $999 for a professional business site, and from $1,999 for eCommerce and custom builds. Every plan includes an SEO build worth around $2,000 at no extra cost, and final pricing is confirmed in a free quote.

mainEntity.name: What is included in the free SEO build?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every website includes SEO-optimised content written for you, schema markup on every page, technical SEO implementation, and Google Search Console and Analytics setup — an SEO package worth approximately $2,000, included free.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer white label web design for agencies?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Nifty Websites Australia provides white label web design, web development and SEO delivered entirely under your agency’s brand, with reseller pricing and reliable turnaround.
